title: The Morning the Deadliest War in History Began

sections.name: Hook
lines: w_hook
Just before five in the morning, on the first of September, 1939, a German battleship opened fire on a small Polish fort.
w_title
It was the opening shot of the deadliest war in human history.

sections.name: The invasion
lines: w_map
Within hours, German troops poured into Poland from the west, the north, and the south.
w_planes
Planes bombed Polish towns and cities from the air.
w_fort
At the fort, called Westerplatte, around two hundred soldiers held out for seven days.

sections.name: The world joins
lines: w_declare
Britain and France had promised to defend Poland. On the third of September, they declared war on Germany.
w_east
Two weeks later, the Soviet Union invaded Poland from the east.

sections.name: Six years
lines: w_globe
The war spread across Europe, Africa, Asia, and the Pacific.
w_toll
By the time it ended, in 1945, somewhere between seventy and eighty-five million people had died.
w_candle
Most of them were civilians. And it all began with one shot, at a small fort by the sea.
d_outro
Follow for more moments from history you won't forget.
